AnyPS5 progress diagrams and source data

Source project: [boykopovar/AnyPS5](https://github.com/boykopovar/AnyPS5)
Source snapshot: commit `53aea1ff3416b7f23853e85a80eb5aa87856a820` (2026-10-13).
Upstream README declares GNU GPL version 2 only; repository metadata reports `GPL-2.0`. See [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt).

`progress.svg`, `history.svg`, `badge-libraries.svg`, `badge-shaders.svg`, `progress.json`, and `history.json` are byte-for-byte copies of the published GitHub Pages assets fetched 2026-10-13. `progress-keyed.svg` is an adapted copy of `progress.svg` with stable IDs and data attributes added to the existing module groups, matched to `progress.json`; its geometry, colors, and displayed text are unchanged.

The diagrams and progress data are generated by upstream `tools/progress.py` and `tools/progress_history.py`. Any further adaptation or distribution should retain this attribution and GPL-2.0-only licensing.
